sections.overall: The two best matches were best from the Continental Cup Challenge: Jon Moxley vs Jay White (8.14) and Claudio Castagnoli vs Daniel Garcia (8.06). With the semi-final draw revealed, Moxley vs Castagnoli in an all-Death Riders match could be a banger!
sections.mens: No other standout matches this week. Neither of the CCC quarter final matches wowed and the other gains/losses were through the various Trios matches in the week.
sections.womens: Maya World did double duty this week: defending the TBS Title on Dynamite and challenging for the World Title against Willow Nightingale (7.05) on Collision. No big changes to the rankings though.
sections.menstag: One decent Men's Tag (6.57) on Collision, with new pairings. As before, several within Trios matches but no big changes either way this week. The division is in sore need of some dedicated Tag Team matches.
sections.womenstag: No Women's Tag Teams featured this week. AEW is very much building towards the big title match at All In. Hopefully that will deliver as there are so few active teams.
sections.trios: Another busy week with the Trios Division - three separate matches! Is this all building towards a surprise debut at All In?! Although none especially delivered, it's good to see the division get some exposure.
